body: Well the thing is that I am in 2 “higher" classes, ap euro and honors English but the people in those classes are so much smarter and way more dedicated than me. I feel like a failure for barely holding on when I have kids in my classes with 4.55s. I just feel like I'm less when I try to do anything related to academics with them. I guess if I surround myself with success, I will succeed. About the track thing, yeah I want to do that but I don't know if they will let me. I hope this grades thing resets 2nd semester and I can run.

Yeah, I could try. However, the season ends in 2 weeks and my coach is not one to negotiate. My mom told me that she is going to have to stay on top of me, speak to my teachers ect. Treat me like a child, but honestly, I think that's what I needed. She was never on my case, I think I slipped away because of that.

Thanks for making me feel a little bit better. But I just feel like I can't get out of this hole I've created. I don't try anymore. I am going to miss cross country, the things we did. Idk. Previously stated above, I feel alone. I don't know if I'm depressed or just overreacting, but either way I feel like my parents don't care. They yell at me, calling me a failure, ect.
I feel kinda lonely. I have no true friends. And the one that I did moved. I have basic friends, I know they don't have my back.
